note: A `devup.json` `extends` entry naming a file that does not exist now prints a warning naming that file and the config that lists it (`[devup-ui] <config> extends <file>, which does not exist, so it adds nothing to the theme`) instead of being silently ignored. The build still goes on without it, and dev servers keep watching the path, so the theme reloads once the file is created. A project without a devup.json stays quiet. No new build errors.
